claim: accept: "pinot nero chardonnay 90 percent millesimato always riserva at 36 months"
because: The Alta Langa disciplinare sets the base minimum at thirty months on the lees and 36 months only for Riserva. The third point the question asks for is the 30-month minimum, and this accept entry leaves it out. Read as 'always riserva at 36 months', it credits an answer that says every Alta Langa is a 36-month Riserva, which is false. (Consorzio disciplinare: 'trenta mesi'; Riserva '36 mesi'; vintage compulsory.)
fix: pinot nero chardonnay 90 percent millesimato always 30 months on lees riserva 36
